<translate>
<!--T:6-->
The '''World Tournament Announcer''' hosts the [[Special:MyLanguage/World Martial Arts Tournament|World Martial Arts Tournament]] on its island in the ocean. Talk to him to enter the tournament.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding him == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
The announcer stands by the tournament ring, next to [[Special:MyLanguage/Mr. Satan|Mr. Satan]]. The island generates once per world in the ocean: find it with <code>/dmzlocate budokai_tenkaichi</code> or with the map sold by the [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsule Corp Assistant|Capsule Corp Assistant]].
</translate>

<translate>
== In the tournament == <!--T:9-->

<!--T:10-->
The announcer is the host of the World Martial Arts Tournament, a non-lethal four-star bracket that ends with [[Special:MyLanguage/Gohan|Gohan (End)]], Majin Vegeta and the champion, [[Special:MyLanguage/Mr. Satan|Mr. Satan]]. Press '''Tournament''' in his dialogue to open the tournament screen, then '''Enter''' while you are within 12 blocks of him. See [[Special:MyLanguage/World Martial Arts Tournament|World Martial Arts Tournament]] for the fighters and rewards, and [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments|Tournaments]] for how entering and bouts work.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:11-->

<!--T:12-->
Right-click the announcer to open his dialogue. He greets you with one of several welcome lines and offers '''Tournament''', which opens the tournament screen.

<!--T:13-->
He teaches no skills and gives no quests. He talks to every player, whatever their [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]]. Like the [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|masters]], he stays in place, can't be pushed and can't be hurt. He is never drawn as a fighter in any tournament.
</translate>
